sermon.title: Creator
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that God created mankind instantly, male and female, in his own image, and that we share his goodness, truth, holiness and eternity. The second creation is the new birth by the Spirit and the word, which shows in a changed life: putting off lying, anger and theft and putting on kindness and forgiveness. Exercising what we learn matters more than learning.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: “Hebrews 6” called faith a baby doctrine (Hebrews 6:1–2 lists faith among first principles); sinless Jesus described with ordinary bodily needs; “the church never gave anything to unbelievers” and “Jesus never gave anything to the poor” as spoken. Sensitive content kept as spoken: homosexuals, bisexuals and pedophiles not created by God; Muslims at Mecca; welfare and unwed mothers; government giving.

scriptures.text_nkjv: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept, Line upon line, line upon line, Here a little, there a little.”

faqs.question: Did God take billions of years to create?
faqs.answer: No—he spoke and it was done instantly.

faqs.question: Is a miracle proof that a messenger is from God?
faqs.answer: No—signs are not approval of the messenger; the message is.

faqs.question: What is God like?
faqs.answer: God is a spirit, a person who is a spirit.

faqs.question: Does how Jesus wore his hair matter for holiness?
faqs.answer: No—holiness is obeying what God asked.

faqs.question: Are we saved to do works?
faqs.answer: We are saved to do good works, though we can’t work our own way into eternity.

faqs.question: Is being born with a disability a punishment?
faqs.answer: No—you had nothing to do with it, and it doesn’t make you second class.

faqs.question: How are we born again?
faqs.answer: By the Spirit and the word working together.

faqs.question: Is faith the main thing?
faqs.answer: He calls faith a baby doctrine; the new man is more important.

faqs.question: Is Christianity a religion?
faqs.answer: He says no—religion is man-made; Christianity is a God-made relationship.

faqs.question: How did he overcome lying?
faqs.answer: Scriptures on his mirror and dashboard and prayer, until God brought his tongue under control.

faqs.question: Who should give to the needy?
faqs.answer: People who work, not the government.
